Article7 pp8–9 grants only resits for Florence LET-KGB225 and Kunstwerelden LET-KGB711; it does not reinstate them as ordinary new-entrant requirements. Future2027–30 pages instead prescribe Florence10 and Kunstwerelden5, while currentB3 has career/PPO5 and a restricted5EC choice. Neither the old2025–26 combined120EC/minor40 structure nor conditional Article6 abroad route can silently repair this. Current catalogue Paris points back to OER, without a distinct repeat unit. This is a positive published-document discrepancy, not transient source inaccessibility.

audience.programmeDescription: Art History at Radboud studies artworks, architecture and visual culture in their historical contexts, from antiquity to the present. It combines visual analysis, art-historical theories and methods, museum visits and independent research.
audience.comparisonExplanation: A complete UCR comparison is withheld while Radboud’s current curriculum needs clarification. The same Paris course appears in two years, leaving 10 EC without a verified distinct allocation. Art history, heritage and visual-media connections at UCR remain promising, but they are not approved programmes here.

curriculum.limitation: The degree is 180 EC. This list accounts for 170 distinct EC because the same 10-EC Paris course appears in both year 2 and year 3. The remaining 10 EC need clarification. Future Florence and Kunstwerelden courses are not treated as current replacements. This is a partial list, not a complete degree pathway. Required first-year mentoring, the Dutch academic-language diagnostic and second-year personal/professional development add no credits. Attendance applies to mentoring and seminars.
